summary: Three unchanged independently accepted roots; complete standard-only axiom probes and full printed theorem types.

modules.printed_full_types:
PaidBinaryIncrement.machine_result : ∀ (xs : List Bool) (oldFlag : Bool),
  PaidBinaryIncrement.run (PaidBinaryIncrement.totalTime xs) (PaidBinaryIncrement.initial xs oldFlag) =
      PaidBinaryIncrement.final xs ∧
    PaidBinaryIncrement.Halted (PaidBinaryIncrement.final xs) ∧
      ∀ k < PaidBinaryIncrement.totalTime xs,
        ¬PaidBinaryIncrement.Halted (PaidBinaryIncrement.run k (PaidBinaryIncrement.initial xs oldFlag))
PaidBinaryIncrement.output_value : ∀ (xs : List Bool),
  CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value (PaidBinaryIncrement.outputWord xs) = CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value xs + 1
PaidBinaryIncrement.machine_prefix_storage : ∀ (xs : List Bool) (oldFlag : Bool) (k : ℕ),
  PaidBinaryIncrement.cells (PaidBinaryIncrement.run k (PaidBinaryIncrement.initial xs oldFlag)) ≤ xs.length + 3

IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.machine_result : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy bl br : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers) (held oldSign oldFlag : Bool),
  CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value yp + 1 < 2 ^ yp.length →
    IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.run (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.totalTime xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar)
          (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar held oldSign oldFlag) =
        IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar ∧
      IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.Halted (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) ∧
        ∀ k < IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.totalTime xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar,
          ¬IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.Halted
              (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.run k
                (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar held oldSign oldFlag))
IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.output_value : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value yp + 1 < 2 ^ yp.length →
    CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
        {
          numerator :=
            SequentialBitAddition.signedValue
              (ReusableDyadicOutput.lowWord xp (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.incremented yp) xs ys sx sy er ar)
              (ReusableDyadicOutput.signBit xp (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.incremented yp) xs ys sx sy er ar),
          fractionalBits :=
            CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value
              (EncodedDyadicAddition.commonWord xp (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.incremented yp) er) } =
      ↑(SequentialBitAddition.signedValue xs sx) / 2 ^ CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value xp +
        ↑(SequentialBitAddition.signedValue ys sy) / 2 ^ CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value yp / 2
IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.machine_prefix_storage : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy bl br : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers) (held oldSign oldFlag : Bool),
  CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value yp + 1 < 2 ^ yp.length →
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.cells
          (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.run k
            (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar held oldSign oldFlag)) ≤
        max (xp.length + yp.length + xs.length + ys.length + 8)
          (IncrementedSourceDyadicAddition.additionBound xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar)

WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.machine_result : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy bl br : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers) (held oldSign oldFlag : Bool),
  WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.run (WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.totalTime xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar)
        (WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar held oldSign oldFlag) =
      WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar ∧
    WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.Halted (WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) ∧
      ∀ k < WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.totalTime xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar,
        ¬WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.Halted
            (WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.run k
              (WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar held oldSign oldFlag))
WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.output_value : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
      {
        numerator :=
          SequentialBitAddition.signedValue
            (ReusableDyadicOutput.lowWord xp (PaidBinaryIncrement.outputWord yp) xs ys sx sy er ar)
            (ReusableDyadicOutput.signBit xp (PaidBinaryIncrement.outputWord yp) xs ys sx sy er ar),
        fractionalBits :=
          CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value
            (EncodedDyadicAddition.commonWord xp (PaidBinaryIncrement.outputWord yp) er) } =
    ↑(SequentialBitAddition.signedValue xs sx) / 2 ^ CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value xp +
      ↑(SequentialBitAddition.signedValue ys sy) / 2 ^ CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value yp / 2
WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.machine_prefix_storage : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy bl br : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers) (held oldSign oldFlag : Bool) (k : ℕ),
  WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.cells
      (WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.run k
        (WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar held oldSign oldFlag)) ≤
    max (xp.length + yp.length + xs.length + ys.length + 9)
      (WidenedSourceDyadicAddition.additionBound xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar)

acceptance_note: Exact source-bound acceptance. All three roots are diagnostic-free. All original failures and repairs are preserved separately.
limits: Marked input words, finite fields and blank work/output tapes are supplied; source exponent uses an independent working tape with blank exterior.
The fixed-width predecessor rejects overflow. The widening successor physically writes one new marker cell when needed and removes the successful-result capacity premise.
The working exponent and prior overflow flag are overwritten. Original packed-source preservation requires a separate paid acquisition/caller interface.
Exact time and prefix storage use the actual widened exponent width and retain numeric-gap-dependent unary production; no global uniform multiplier cost follows.
Separate accepted parity-qualified same-width physical half/fixed-Q components do not by themselves supply initialization, the complete selected caller/schedule or its uniform charge.
